answer: A cloned still of a unique object can mint many voters. Each applicant gets one surveyed station on a published coastal ridge. They film one continuous take: weigh a serialized botanical kernel on the public scale, then press a catalogued bronze relic into wet clay to lift its serial. Clerks post C=blake3(addr||station_id||mass_mg||relic_serial||frame_root). Fee is 0.27 POA; 13 POA bonds for seven epochs. Auditors re-weigh the sealed kernel and match the clay lift to the catalog. A reused station, swapped kernel, or twin imprint seizes the bond and darkens both keys for ten epochs.
